newsitem.title: USA: Police capture alleged ATM bandit.
newsitem.headline: Police capture alleged ATM bandit.

text.p: Police said Friday they arrested a man for allegedly using a stolen tow truck to rip an automatic bank teller machine from its concrete foundation and pry $14,000 in cash out of the machine.
Eric Hatton, 26, of Bethpage, Tennessee, was held in lieu of a $100,000 bond, charged with stealing the cash and the bank machine, which police valued at more than $46,000.
Richard Smith, assistant police chief in this town northeast of Nashville, said the tow truck and the stolen bank machine were found abandoned in a cornfield on Tuesday.
Details were not immediately available on how Hatton was caught.
The machine was a stand-alone device that was taken from in front of the Farmers Bank of Portland.
